story.fullStory:
Vulfmon's "I Can't Party" — original release 2022. 1987), also known by the mononym Vulfmon, is an American multi-instrumentalist, songwriter, record producer, and video producer based in Los Angeles.

He is best known as the founder and bandleader of the funk band Vulfpeck.

He released his first full-length album, Here We Go Jack, in 2022 and has since released three additional albums.
